title: Opportunity
description: PRD §8.2 — federal opportunity record (live SAM.gov, cached, or seeded fixture).

slug.description: Stable URL segment; SAM-linked rows often derive from notice id / solicitation.

source_notice_id.description: SAM.gov notice id when ingested — canonical external key alongside raw_payload.

source.description: Origin of the row: sam.gov, manual, or seed.

active.description: Direct mirror of the source active flag where available.

notice_type.description: SAM notice type / combined synopsis label when available.

office_name.description: Sub-tier office label (denormalized for list cards).

psc_code.description: PSC text from source (denormalized); optional FK resolution in DB.

resource_links.description: Attachment / resource URLs from SAM resources API.

opportunity_status.description: Lifecycle for UI filtering (govbase-style Open/Active/Closed, lowercased).

record_kind.description: RFP vs already-awarded contract record when distinguishable.

raw_payload.description: Verbatim source record (e.g. SAM.gov API row) for audit/debug.
